minecraft:written_book_content.title: Recovered: Security Log
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Chief Holloway
pages: Frequency readings up again. Third week running. The techs say it's instrument drift. The techs have not stood Sub-Level 3 watch at 0300 and heard the door breathe.

I've started counting my men by name at the end of each shift. Not by roster. By memory.

Last night I got to twelve and could not remember if there should have been thirteen.
I have requested transfer four times. The requests do not appear in the system. I am beginning to think they never left this site. I am beginning to think I won't either.
